title: anomalyco/opencode
claim: anomalyco/opencode — The open source coding agent.
why_good: OpenCode is an AI coding agent that provides two distinct agents: a full-access build agent for development and a read-only plan agent for code exploration. It allows users to switch seamlessly between agents for tailored coding tasks.
value: Developers and software teams pay for OpenCode to enhance their coding efficiency and safety in exploring new projects, addressing the need for both development and analysis in one tool.
risk: OpenCode may struggle against established IDEs that dominate the market, which offer deep integrations and extensive ecosystems that users are accustomed to.

zh.claim: 用OpenCode，开放源代码的AI编码代理，改变您的编码体验，拥有190,526颗星！
zh.why_good: OpenCode是一个AI编码代理，提供两个不同的代理：用于开发的完全访问构建代理和用于代码探索的只读计划代理。它允许用户无缝切换代理，以满足特定的编码任务。
zh.value: 开发人员和软件团队为OpenCode付费，以提高编码效率和在探索新项目时的安全性，满足一个工具中开发和分析的需求。
zh.risk: OpenCode可能会面临市场上占主导地位的成熟IDE的竞争，这些IDE提供深度集成和用户习惯的广泛生态系统。
